Planned scope

This planned series covers engineering tooling for large-scale system validation, including configurable log analysis, Python automation, SQL queries, and Airflow pipelines for telemetry triage and regression tracking.

Topics to cover

  • Scenario-based log parsing and CSV reporting
  • Python test automation and lab orchestration
  • Telemetry analysis with SQL and Airflow
  • Automated regression detection and bug triage
